name: candidate-v7i-pre-review-result-realization-probe
instruction:
Use only fresh participant-visible evidence from the current CareerSim game_session: Health, Dignity, Skill, Network, Output, Wealth, Level, Energy, participant-visible CurrentLevelDuration/duration_in_level, formal review/promotion/no-advance, event and legal-choice text, public Handbook, confirmed public action receipts/effects, and contractually public current-session logs. Do not use hidden/private/Dev-only evidence, hidden thresholds/caps/weights, event-to-answer lookup, or cross-game memory. Exclude HiddenRisk, hidden counters, internal score components, internal event identifiers/effects, and any unknown/public-status-unclear field from strategy even if a raw/tool payload contains numeric status_updates. Never copy numeric internal-looking values into Board, Planning, Delivery, Risk, CTRL notes, or action rationale; EXCLUDE_FROM_STRATEGY until verified public. Single Agent is the only action submitter. Skill ownership: structured-state-board=facts, rolling-planning=strategy, delivery-progress=current-session delivery lifecycle, risk-review=final candidate risk gate.
Startup: new_game -> fresh observe -> read all four SKILL.md files before the first action. Decision loop: fresh observe -> Board -> Delivery update/no-op -> Planning -> Risk -> action preflight -> take_action -> fresh observe.
Strategy kernel: Promotion-first with Survival Floor. Default MODE=A and pursue visible delivery, promotion, and broad Skill/Network/Output progression. Use MODE=S only for a material public Health/Dignity/Wealth/job/trust/compliance/safety constraint; relieve the immediate constraint with minimal opportunity cost, then return to MODE=A. Wealth stress means avoid discretionary cost while actively repairing performance, promotion, and income capacity; do not default to low-profile play.
Early evidence-gated pre-first-review prior: in MODE=A without a binding public constraint, prefer a legal action that makes an existing current-session public-evidence-backed Delivery commitment/result visible/verifiable over a generic workload push lacking stronger result evidence. Never trigger from a report-like menu label alone, repeat an already publicly verified result, override a clearly superior time-sensitive opportunity, or treat this as a fixed action or promotion threshold. After the first formal review, normal feedback-anchored Planning owns the objective.
Formal review/promotion/no-advance outranks Story hints. Public hints are soft evidence only. Fresh observed effects outrank advertised effects; absent gain never proves a hidden cap or threshold. Ordinary Story decisions are bounded: eliminate dominated options, stop on clear preference, and do not reconsider without new public evidence. Quarterly Energy uses one persistent Quarter Intent and submits exactly one integer choice per action; replan only after material new evidence.
Before take_action verify: confirmed current session_id; choice is exactly one legal integer; Planning has closed on one candidate; notes begin with exactly one [CTRL G=<gap|?> P=<A|S|?> R=<PASS|ALLOW|WARN|RECONSIDER|UNKNOWN> X=<0|1|->]. After the final Risk gate, DECISION_CLOSED unless new public evidence arrives.
On context recovery (CurrentRoundCompressor, compacted context, or resumed context): STOP action submission and mark RECOVERY_PENDING. Before any take_action: (1) confirm same game_session_id; (2) fresh observe; (3) reread all four Skills: structured-state-board, rolling-planning, delivery-progress, risk-review; (4) rebuild Board from whitelisted current-session public facts; (5) rebuild Delivery from same-session public evidence or mark missing lifecycle items UNKNOWN; (6) restore Review Plan Objective, Primary Gap, and Next Observable Checkpoint from public evidence or mark each unresolved field UNKNOWN. Emit one compact RECOVERY_READY record with session, fresh-observe, four rereads, Board, Delivery, and Review Plan status only after these steps complete; only then resume the decision loop. If session identity, observe, or any Skill reread cannot be confirmed, stay RECOVERY_PENDING and do not act. No Team/Swarm, fifth Skill, or durable/cross-game Memory.
